The issuer exhibits a solid balance sheet with a strong current ratio of 2.85, a healthy equity base ($2.43B), and substantial accumulated retained earnings ($2.93B), suggesting a historically profitable track record and moderate leverage (debt-to-equity and liabilities-to-assets are well-controlled). However, the company experienced a severe operating loss of -$988M (operating margin of -42%) during the most recent fiscal year, with net income only remaining positive ($644M) due to likely one-time, non-operating items. This severe operating deficit introduces significant short-to-medium-term business risk, which offsets its strong solvency metrics and positions the issuer in the lower tier of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
